highlights.title: BloodByte
highlights.description: An AI-assisted emergency blood donation project. The public repository identifies it as a Google Developer Hackathon project; this is project participation, not an award claim.

highlights.title: ContextSync
highlights.description: A browser-to-terminal bridge project for moving code, errors, and files into AI coding tools.

highlights.title: Veeva System Training
highlights.description: A public practice repository for automation engineering topics. The roadmap is presented as learning focus, not completed expertise.

highlights.title: OpsGuardian
highlights.description: A workflow project whose repository identifies Jest and Supertest integration tests alongside human approval gates.
